specification_prompt: Deploy an ultra-low latency, real-time edge vision pipeline for high-risk industrial manufacturing and construction environments. The system must process RTSP or live camera feeds at 60+ FPS, perform multi-person tracking, verify Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) compliance including hardhats and high-visibility safety vests, and enforce dynamic geofenced hazard zones around automated machinery. When a safety breach occurs—such as an unequipped worker entering a robotic cell or a trip/fall event—the pipeline must immediately generate millisecond-grade telemetry over MQTT, log structured JSON forensic records, and trigger an external hardware closed-loop actuator (siren/strobe and emergency machine halt via ESP32) to prevent workplace injury.

target_hardware.primary: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano / Jetson AGX Orin (JetPack 6.0)
target_hardware.local_hybrid: Cross-platform x86_64 / Windows fallback with ONNX Runtime & OpenCV

functional_requirements.description: Multi-person and industrial mobile equipment detection with high confidence filtering (>0.55).
High-accuracy PPE verification: classify Hardhat (Compliant / Non-Compliant) and Safety Vest (Compliant / Non-Compliant) per detected worker.
Interactive polygon zone containment algorithms to detect perimeter intrusion into High-Voltage or Robotic hazard zones in real time.
Produce structured JSON metadata events and broadcast over MQTT within 50ms of violation onset.
Physical feedback loop via ESP32 micro-controller driving audio buzzer alarms, LED strobes, and emergency interlock relays.
Real-time interactive glassmorphic web console showing live video stream, live violation feed, interactive geofence zone editor, and performance diagnostics.
functional_requirements.ui_stack: HTML5, Vanilla Modern CSS, JavaScript, WebSocket / HTTP stream
